hotspots.title: House GOP Impeachment Push Against Pete Hegseth
hotspots.blurb: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is fiercely fighting back against articles of impeachment filed against him in the House over military operations in Iran. Hegseth and key administration allies like Vice President JD Vance have denounced the effort as 'sabotage' and a 'farce,' triggering intense partisan combat across right-wing media outlets.
hotspots.affect: The rare spectacle of impeaching a sitting Defense Secretary over war conduct sparks explosive defensive outrage and existential political rhetoric across MAGA media.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Pope Leo XIV's visit to Argentina and his sermons emphasizing economic justice for the vulnerable have ignited a fierce ideological confrontation with Javier Milei's government. Opposition lawmakers are demanding formal accounting for government expenditure on VIP papal events, while right-wing commentators push back against papal criticism of libertarian austerity.
hotspots.affect: Direct moral counter-messaging from the Catholic Church against Milei's economic doctrine triggers deep moral charge and intense political polarization.

hotspots.title: Santiago Abascal & David Broncano TV Clash
hotspots.blurb: Vox leader Santiago Abascal's high-stakes appearance on Spanish public television's 'La Revuelta' continues to dominate headlines after host David Broncano expressed regret over the interview's framing. Vox and right-wing media figures are claiming victory over high viewership while accusing left-wing political actors of orchestrating pressure and censorship.
hotspots.affect: Culture-war animosity over state television, media bias claims, and public broadsides give this televised confrontation high emotional investment.

hotspots.title: Krakow Mass Shooting & Far-Right Suspect
hotspots.blurb: Poland remains in national mourning following a mass shooting in Krakow, where official investigations cited the gunman's interest in far-right terror material. PiS politicians and conservative outlets have launched aggressive counter-attacks against Prime Minister Donald Tusk's administration, accusing the government of politicking and false narrative spin.
hotspots.affect: Mass violence combined with rapid partisan narrative warfare between government authorities and conservative opposition drives severe affective charge.

hotspots.title: Viktor Orbán's Brother Arrested in Human Smuggling Probe
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian authorities have taken Áron Orbán, younger brother of Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, into custody as part of a human smuggling investigation. Prime Minister Orbán and Fidesz allies have lashed out at the detention, framing it as a political hit job orchestrated by political opponents and adding Áron Orbán to Fidesz's list of 'political prisoners.'
hotspots.affect: Criminal enforcement against the ruling family member provokes extreme political grievance framing and high-stakes accusations of weaponized justice.
